title: COUNTROWS of an empty table, plus 0, is 0
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( T, FALSE ) ) + 0 )

source.supports: the article's example, on a table named Table

derivation: FILTER ( T, FALSE ) keeps none of T's three rows, so COUNTROWS returns BLANK, and BLANK + 0 is 0. COUNTROWS is a whole number and so is 0.
